'''Brain-wave projection''' was a field of technology employed in the making of [[mind control device]]s. They were developed at the request of [[Baroness/Legends|Baroness]] [[Omnino]] of [[Vena]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
